board.name: Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants

licence.title: Physician Assistant regular license
licence.renewalDeadline: Every other year on or before the licensee's birthday; late fee after 30 days; license expires 90 days after the birthday

ce.categoryRules: Category I CME approved by AAPA, AMA, AOA or another accreditor acceptable to the board; prorated hours in the first biennial period.

topicMandates.topic: Opioid-related, substance use disorder-related or addiction-related CE
topicMandates.appliesTo: By statute, Schedule II prescribers with a DEA registration (counts within the 40 hours); the PA board's renewal page applies it to all renewing PAs.

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours opioid, substance use disorder or addiction CE each renewal cycle for DEA registered Schedule II prescribers.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Under 8,000 board-certified clinical practice hours: signed supervision agreement kept on file at the PA's main practice location and produced to the board on request (not filed with the board). With 8,000 hours certified by the board: no supervision agreement; the PA practises with a collaborating physician or entity and collaborates, consults or refers as the setting's policies require.
practice.notes: A supervising physician may supervise no more than six PAs working at the same time. The 8,000 hour certification is issued by the board on documentation.

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Board approval plus DEA registration is required for Schedule II and III; Schedule IV and V need DEA registration. No separate state controlled substance registration found.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 3 hours opioid or substance use disorder CE each renewal for DEA registered Schedule II prescribers.
prescribing.pdmpNote: CSPMP (Board of Pharmacy) access is tied to a DEA registration with an Arizona address; a utilization report is required before prescribing Schedule II to IV opioids or benzodiazepines (A.R.S. 36-2606). Not a separate controlled substance licence.

facts.value: every other year on birthday
facts.quote: each holder of a regular license shall renew the license every other year on or before the licensee's birthday
forty hours of category I continuing medical education approved by the American academy of physician assistants

facts.value: 40 hours per biennial license period
facts.quote: renewal of a license is conditioned on the licensee completing 40 hours of category I continuing medical education during each biennial license period.
facts.note: Rule text read from Cornell LII's reproduction of the Arizona Administrative Code; apps.azsos.gov returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-01. Re-loaded and matched by the verifier.

facts.quote: deemed satisfied if, at the time of renewal, the licensee holds a certification in good standing from a certifying body approved by the board.
facts.note: Statute says 'a certifying body approved by the board'; the board's approval of NCCPA by name was not loaded. 32-2523(A) also exempts nationally certified PAs from the 10% CME audit.

facts.value: 3 hours each renewal cycle
facts.quote: shall complete a minimum of three hours of opioid-related, substance use disorder-related or addiction-related continuing education each license renewal cycle.
facts.note: The PA board's renewal page says all renewing PAs complete the 3 hours within the 40; the statute limits it to Schedule II prescribers with a DEA registration.

facts.value: required under 8,000 certified hours
facts.quote: A physician assistant who has less than eight thousand hours of clinical practice certified by the board shall work in accordance with a supervision agreement

facts.value: kept on file at practice, not filed with board
facts.quote: The supervision agreement must be kept on file at the main location of the physician assistant's practice

facts.value: collaboration, no supervision agreement
facts.quote: is not required to practice pursuant to a supervision agreement but shall continue to collaborate with, consult with or refer to

facts.value: board certifies 8,000 hours on documentation
facts.quote: shall provide the board with documentation of having completed at least eight thousand hours of clinical practice

facts.value: board approval and DEA registration
facts.quote: without board approval and United States drug enforcement administration registration.

facts.value: must obtain a 12 month CSPMP utilization report before prescribing Schedule II to IV opioid or benzodiazepine
facts.quote: before prescribing an opioid analgesic or benzodiazepine controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV for a patient, shall obtain a patient utilization report

facts.value: board states 3 hours within the 40 for all renewing PAs
facts.cite: Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants, Renewal Opioid CME
facts.quote: All Physician Assistants renewing their licenses are required to complete (3) three hours of CME as part of the 40 hours

facts.value: no more than six PAs working at the same time per supervising physician
facts.quote: A supervising physician shall not supervise more than six physician assistants who work at the same time.

rn.renewalDeadline: Every four years on or before April 1 (late fee after May 1; license expires if not renewed by August 1)
rn.ceNote: No CE hours; renewal requires 960 hours of nursing practice in the previous five years (or a qualifying post-licensure degree or certificate).

aprn.title: RNP (Registered Nurse Practitioner) advanced practice certificate
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Certificate issued by the Board; prescribing and dispensing (P&D) authority applied for with certification
aprn.renewalNote: Certificates issued after July 1, 2004 expire with the RN license or when national certification expires, whichever is first. Renewed on a separate application after the RN licence is renewed (board renewal page).
aprn.ceNote: No state CE hours; renewal requires current national certification and 960 hours of APRN practice in the previous five years.

topicMandates.topic: Opioid-related, substance use disorder-related or addiction-related CE
topicMandates.appliesTo: DEA registered prescribers authorized for Schedule II

prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 45 contact hours of pharmacology or clinical management of drug therapy within 3 years before the P&D application (one-time).
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours opioid, substance use disorder or addiction CE each license renewal cycle for DEA registered Schedule II prescribers.
prescribing.stateCsNote: No separate state controlled substance registration found in the rules or statutes loaded; DEA registration is federal.
prescribing.pdmpNote: CSPMP (Board of Pharmacy) access is tied to a DEA registration with an Arizona address; a utilization report is required before prescribing Schedule II to IV opioids or benzodiazepines (A.R.S. 36-2606). Not a separate controlled substance licence.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: None found. RNPs make independent decisions and must consult or refer when a condition is beyond their knowledge and experience.

unverified: Arizona Administrative Code rules (R4-17-205, R4-19-312, R4-19-506, R4-19-511) were read from Cornell LII's reproduction because apps.azsos.gov returned HTTP 403; statutes were loaded from azleg.gov and board pages from azpa.gov and azbn.gov.

PA: A.R.S. 32-2523(F) deems the 40 hour CME met by certification from 'a certifying body approved by the board'; the board's naming of NCCPA was not loaded. Whether a nationally certified PA must still document the 3 opioid hours separately is not confirmed.
NP: 'full' practice authority rests on the statutory definition (independent decisions) and the absence of any collaboration or transition requirement in the statutes, rules and board pages loaded.
NP and PA: absence of a separate Arizona controlled substance registration is inferred; only DEA, board authority (PA Schedule II and III) and CSPMP access are named.

No other topic mandates (implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, Alzheimer, suicide, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence) were found for PAs or NPs in the statutes, rules and board pages loaded; the federal one-time 8 hour MATE training is federal.
